trap.label: relativas em texto
trap.wrong: People who are bilingual, a tool that it helps communication, a lab where the staff work there.
trap.right: People who are bilingual, a tool that helps communication, a lab where the staff work.
trap.why: Em português é comum repetir o pronome (“a ferramenta que ela ajuda”). Em inglês, o relativo já faz o papel do sujeito ou do lugar.

fix.wrong: A person who she speaks three languages.
fix.right: A person who speaks three languages.

fix.wrong: A place where I work there.

rewrite.prompt: Una com who: “Bilingual people earn more. They speak two languages.”
rewrite.answer: Bilingual people who speak two languages earn more.

rewrite.prompt: Una com that: “A tool helps communication.”
Una com where: “A lab. The staff work in it.”
rewrite.answer: A lab where the staff work.
